videos.desc:
This is a collab with @Ruth_Amos
- Check out her video for more context!
Ruth's video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yq-QBHT9jZw

STL files are now available! They're on MakerWorld: https://makerworld.com/en/@elliswhere 

Thank you to @Polymaker for the filament! And whilst I don't specifically namedrop my own company in the video, all of the gear and other resources I used for this are thanks to Ranglebox. Check us/me out? It's Ranglebox.com!

This is my first video, and what a monster. I bit off just about as much as I can chew + some extra. I'd love to know what you think!

I am @elliswhe
Files for the mega 3D printing collab with @Ruth_Amos are up on MakerWorld! Find them here: https://makerworld.com/en/@elliswhere 🧱🎄

videos.t: Building Mini Battle Robots in Time for Christmas
videos.desc:
Just a little video documenting a little build for some little people. Chill vibes for your Christmas Eve, except of course for the BATTLE TRACTORS! 🎸🎸🎸

This is my second upload! Thank you so much for the incredible response to the Giant Lego Tree video: https://youtu.be/G3WCXHcAFsU
I hope you enjoy this slightly less ambitious project. I did :)

You can find me most places as @elliswhere. Follow me on Instagram for the day to day stuff!
